name: phase_01_membership_role_changes
lock_risk: Adds one uniqueness constraint to the bounded membership table, then creates an initially empty immutable replay table and one tenant-leading index without rewriting role data.
representative_data: Runs against empty, previous-version, and deterministic Phase 01 identity lanes; live tests execute concurrent same-version direct role changes and Audit-outage rollback through the atlas_api role.
query_plan_review: The actor-and-idempotency unique key serializes response-loss replay, the membership primary/tenant key locks one target, and the tenant-leading history index avoids cross-tenant scans.
space_risk: Stores hash-only idempotency/request digests and bounded immutable before/after role references; no cookie, CSRF value, email, purpose text, or arbitrary payload is retained.
forward_fix: Disable the direct role-change route and add a new ordered migration for any replay, grant, constraint, or approval-integration correction while preserving membership and Audit history.
rollback: Disable the direct role-change route before a forward fix; never reverse a committed role change, reactivate invalidated sessions, delete its replay/Audit fact, or enable administrator transitions without Operations approval.
